release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.8

- Fix: Resolved 'Invalid or expired token' error when scheduling calls.
- Persistent Authentication: Mobile login tokens now last for 1 year with automatic background refresh.
- Strict Private Meetings: Meetings with selected participants are private—only the host and invited members can see or join the meeting. Non-invited users are strictly blocked.
- Selective Calling & Auto-Ringing: Only invited members receive incoming call rings, both during manual ringing and scheduled auto-rings.
- Direct Cumulative Updates: Seamless one-step direct update from any earlier version straight to the newest release.
